text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Near the peak of the mountain she aimed 
for, Wonder Acute...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Phew, haah, phew, hah-phew~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My fingertips firmly gripped the summit. 
Even so—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Falu-ko! Falu-ko!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Falco-san... Even though she's exhausted 
from running full out, she still has such 
a bright smile...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Aaaah... It's so bright. Winning and 
losing is just part of racing, but...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I could never give off a radiance like 
that. I guess there really are Umamusume 
who are simply 'the chosen ones.'

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Good work, Acute-san☆ But we're not done 
yet, you know?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
A big performance just as important as a 
race is waiting for us, after all. Right?♪

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That's true. I might not be able to be the 
star like Falco-san, but...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
At the very least, allow me to treat you 
to a nice, suave dance.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gold and silver. Truly, the quality of 
their shine is different. Even so...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"On the track, on the stage, Wonder Acute 
steadfastly saw through what she had to 
do."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thank you. I was shown on TV 
today, so now I...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I managed to encourage the trainees and 
elderly folks at the gym, you see. Told 
them that if they keep working hard bit by 
bit, they can surely shine again.
choice_data_list: Yeah, I think you showed them!
Yeah, I think I was able to prove it!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That's true. But maybe because I saw her 
up close... I actually felt a huge gap 
between myself and Falco-san, who looked 
like a red demon out there.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That was entirely true. There is still a 
considerable gap in achievements between 
her and the champion, Smart Falcon.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
In that case... maybe I'll give running 
one more shot.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, after today's Winning 
Live ended, Falco-san also...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Acute-san, we have to stand on 
the next stage together again, for sure!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
This is my first time taking the stage in 
Kawasaki too♪ Let's go meet the fans who 
are waiting for us!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
What did Falco-san mean by "the stage in 
Kawasaki"...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When you think of Kawasaki, you think of 
Kawasaki Racecourse. And when it comes to 
the GⅠ held there...
choice_data_list:
That would be the Kawasaki Kinen in early 
February.

It'd probably be the Kawasaki Kinen in 
early February, right?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"The Kawasaki Kinen... Well then, maybe 
I'll drop in for a little visit."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
If I can run well alongside Falco-san once 
more, I think she'll finally see that I've 
caught up.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems she has no intention of fiercely 
competing over victory or defeat. But...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Maybe that's fine for Wonder Acute. 
Everyone has their own reasons for 
running.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well Trainer-san, let's get back to 
training... is what I'd like to say, but~.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Maybe we don't have to be super strict 
this time. It's New Year's, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's full-blown year-end mode. In any 
case, let's make sure Wonder Acute gets 
plenty of rest over the New Year.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Next year is next year. I decided to take 
some time to rethink how to approach the 
Kawasaki Kinen.
